name: Apple Fitness+
paraphrase: Apple says only Apple/authorised resellers/licensees may use the Apple Logo in advertising; others need an express written licence to use it on websites/products. Word marks allowed in 'compatible with' phrasing, not prominent, no implied endorsement. Fitness+ is a listed Apple service mark. Page does not mention apps or Fitness+ logo specifically.
notes: Use a text name 'Apple Fitness+' (nominative word mark, no Apple logo) with initials tile. Apple is a litigious, strict brand owner; no licensed-asset route for subscription trackers found.

name: Strava
conditions: No modification or recolour beyond placing on brand tile
Add non-affiliation line in About/Legal ('Logos are trademarks of their owners, shown for identification')
If used: logo must not be part of app icon/name, not more prominent than your branding, unaltered, never animated
paraphrase: Strava API brand guidelines: reference only as 'Powered by Strava'/'Compatible with Strava'; truthful plain-text mentions fine; do not use any part of a Strava logo as app icon; do not modify/animate logos; no implied endorsement. These bind API users; Buddget does not use the Strava API for this tile.
notes: Guidelines target API integrators; the logo-as-identifier use is not explicitly covered. Plain text name is clearly allowed; a wordmark-as-text alternative is safer.
